category: 微分方程 / 常微分方程
literal_source_claim_zh: 近可积哈密顿系统的稳定性
literal_source_claim_en: Stability of nearly integrable Hamiltonian systems.
statement_blocker: The repository supplies an umbrella theory label and qualitative stability gloss, not one proposition. It fixes no KAM branch, phase space, Hamiltonian contract, regularity, norm, nondegeneracy, frequency arithmetic, perturbation threshold, invariant object, conclusion strength, estimates, measure statement, ordered binders, or boundary cases. Selecting a Kolmogorov, Arnold, Moser, positive-measure, isoenergetic, differentiable, or other KAM theorem would invent or substitute missing mathematics.
target_decision: preserve the non-propositional KAM-theory record until an independently reviewed target correction selects, redirects, or splits one exact source proposition with explicit ownership relative to neighboring targets
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted correction must fix the scalar field, finite action and angle dimensions, phase space, action and torus domains, Hamiltonian and parameter carriers, universes, topology, symplectic convention, regularity structures, function spaces, and norms.
conclusion: Open: the repository names a theory but does not choose invariant-torus persistence, a fixed-frequency or shifted-frequency conjugacy, a positive-measure Cantor family, an isoenergetic result, an invariant curve, finite-time action confinement, or another truth-valued conclusion.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; a corrected statement must resolve every dimension, domain, resonance, nondegeneracy, perturbation, regularity, frequency, embedding, measure, and boundary case in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: Kolmogorov's 1954 real-analytic persistence theorem for a nondegenerate conditionally periodic motion
Arnold's 1963 proof and near-integrable Hamiltonian formulation of Kolmogorov's theorem
a modern analytic positive-measure Cantor-family theorem for most suitable nonresonant tori
Moser's differentiable invariant-curve or twist-map branch
an isoenergetic, lower-dimensional, reversible, Gevrey, finite-differentiability, PDE, or other KAM variant
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: torus dimension zero or one and empty or boundary action domains
zero, resonant, rationally dependent, or non-Diophantine frequencies
singular Hessian, frequency map, or source-specific twist matrix
zero perturbation and perturbations at or beyond the selected threshold
loss of analytic width or insufficient differentiability
frequency preservation versus shift and phase-nonunique embeddings
destroyed resonant tori, lower-dimensional tori, and multiple nearby embeddings
one-torus persistence, positive-measure survival, and finite-time action stability
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1370's original Kolmogorov-Arnold theorem silently used as the entire umbrella theory
THM-M-1371 Moser twist theorem or a single invariant-curve theorem for an annulus map
THM-M-1373 generic Hamiltonian systems or THM-M-1547 Liouville-Arnold integrability
the out-of-scope THM-P-0774 physics wording transferred without an accepted identity and ownership decision
the unrelated Kolmogorov-Arnold representation or superposition theorem
Siegel linearization, Birkhoff normal form, recurrence, adiabatic invariance, or Arnold-diffusion bounds
a structure that stores the invariant torus, conjugacy, stability, or persistence conclusion as data
generic analytic, Fourier, symplectic, ODE, or flow infrastructure alone
numerical integration, phase portraits, sampled frequencies, or floating-point smallness evidence
the catalog's untrusted verified label or the discovery probe as source or proof credit

freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source or target correction; root selection, redirection, split, or ownership decision; source edition, theorem locator, attribution, translation, correction, erratum, definition, hypothesis, conclusion, proof-boundary, or reviewer finding; Hamiltonian, phase-space, dimension, regularity, norm, nondegeneracy, arithmetic, perturbation, threshold, embedding, conjugacy, frequency, estimate, measure, time, or boundary decision; Lean target, toolchain or dependency pin; assurance profile, validator, recipe, or any owned artifact. status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. H5 classifies the catalog's KAM-theory label and stability gloss as not yet a stable proposition; it does not refute or classify any properly stated KAM theorem. The source-family leads and API probe supply discovery evidence only. No canonical statement, H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, theorem completion, or master acceptance is claimed.
